infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Brazos saves job and work photos you choose to share to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock hidden chats with Face ID.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Share your live location in a chat while a job is underway.

plugins.photosPermission: BRAZOS uses your photo library so you can attach photos and videos to jobs, messages, reviews, and your profile.
plugins.cameraPermission: BRAZOS uses the camera to take photos and videos of jobs, completed work, and your profile.
plugins.microphonePermission: BRAZOS uses the microphone to record voice messages and job videos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: BRAZOS uses your location to show nearby jobs and to place job locations on the map.

plugins.microphonePermission: BRAZOS uses the microphone to record voice messages and job videos.
BRAZOS uses your microphone only while you are searching by voice, and stops listening when you finish speaking.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Speech is recognized on your device to turn what you say into a search. Nothing is sent to a server.
